title: 第三百九十七章 宝石紫蛋第三百九十六章 拉明
slug: 开局a级禁物玩家给我打工
content_zh:
第三百九十七章宝石紫蛋！
剑刃与刀锋交击的脆响还在大厅穹顶下回荡。
拉明的漆黑短刀被【真言蔷薇】架在半空中，刀尖距离林奇的咽喉只有不到一掌的距离，但这一掌的距离在他恢复重心的瞬间就变成了天堑。
拉明低头看着林奇左手腕上那一闪而过的金光，眼神里第一次出现了真正意义上的意外。
命运序列的能力让他习惯性地在战斗前就摸清对手的底牌，但【正轮印记】不在他掌握的情报之内。
他并不知道那禁物的具体效果，但他亲眼看到了对方在他用【夭折之子】改写现实之后依然稳住了重心。
这种事在他过去的战斗中从未发生过。
命运序列的能力虽然不是直接攻击，但通过环境变化制造的破绽向来是致命的。
那些被他杀死的人，大多数都倒在了石砖碎裂、吊灯坠落、楼梯塌陷这类【意外】之后紧随而来的刀锋之下。
但对方没有倒下，甚至还在站稳的同一瞬间挥出了左手的剑。
拉明撤步后退，鞋底在石地板上滑出一声短促的摩擦音。
他没有选择和林奇正面拼剑，而是在后退的同时再次翻开了【夭折之子】。
羽毛笔落入右手，笔尖在纸面上划出两道横线和一道竖线，组成一个简单而扭曲的符号。
他写完之后没有合上书，而是直接将书页撕下来，往空中一抛。
书页在空中燃烧起来。
灰烬散落的同时，林奇头顶上方的吊灯链条断了。
上百斤重的铁质吊灯带着刺耳的金属断裂声和呼啸的风声。
林奇没有抬头。
【绯辰缚玫之约】展开。
力场在吊灯坠落路径的侧面施加了一个斜向的推力，将吊灯的下坠轨迹偏转了大约十五度。

吊灯擦着他的后背砸在地面上，铁质框架和石砖撞击的巨响震得整座大厅都在颤抖。
蜡烛从灯架上弹飞出去，滚落在石地上，火焰舔舐着碎裂的砖缝。
碎片从背后溅射过来，林奇没有回头，引斥力在身后形成了一道无形的屏障，将那些碎片全部挡在了距离身体半米之外的地方。
拉明没有浪费吊灯坠落创造的时间窗口。
他跟在吊灯后面欺身而上，漆黑短刀从下往上撩起，目标正是林奇握剑的左腕。
这个攻击目标的选择暴露了拉明对【正轮印记】的判断。
拉明看的很清楚，对方在规避【夭折之子】影响的时候左手手背闪过了一丝光芒！
先废掉林奇的左腕就能同时废掉那个禁物和左手剑。
这个判断在战术上是正确的。
但林奇没有给他碰到自己左腕的机会。
审判的枪口从剑锋下方探出，三发子弹倾泻而出。
砰！砰！砰！
铛铛铛——
拉明可不是呆瓜！
他不知道【正轮印记】不代表他不知道【审判】。
【夭折之子】里提到过这个左轮类型的【A级禁物】被里昂留给了伊萨里斯。
拉明看的十分清楚，这三发是没有经过任何附魔的普通子弹，挡掉就好了。
然而......
就在他的刀刃触碰到第三发子弹之时发现了不对。
第三百九十七章宝石紫蛋！

匕首上传来的触感不对。
content_en:
Chapter 397 Gemstone Purple Egg!
The crisp sound of sword blade clashing still echoed under the dome of the hall.
Laming's jet-black short knife was held in mid-air by [Rose of Mantra]. The tip of the knife was less than a palm away from Lynch's throat, but the distance of this palm turned into a chasm the moment he regained his center of gravity.
Laming looked down at the flash of golden light on Lynch's left wrist, and for the first time there was real surprise in his eyes.
The ability of the Destiny Sequence allows him to habitually find out the opponent's trump card before a battle, but the [Sign of the Right Wheel] is not among the information he has.
He didn't know the specific effect of the forbidden object, but he saw with his own eyes that the other party still stabilized his center of gravity after he used [The Son of Death] to rewrite reality.
This had never happened in his past fights.
Although the ability of Destiny Sequence is not a direct attack, the loopholes created through environmental changes are always fatal.
Most of those he killed fell to the blades that followed [accidents] such as broken stone bricks, falling chandeliers, and collapsed stairs.
But the opponent did not fall down, and even swung the sword in his left hand at the same moment he stood firm.
Lamin stepped back, the soles of his shoes making a short scraping sound on the stone floor.
He did not choose to fight with Lynch head-on, but while retreating, he opened the [Dead Son] again.
The quill pen fell into his right hand, and the pen tip drew two horizontal lines and one vertical line on the paper, forming a simple but twisted symbol.
After he finished writing, he did not close the book, but simply tore the pages out and threw them in the air.
The pages burned in the air.
As the ashes scattered, the chain of the chandelier above Lynch's head broke.
The iron chandelier, which weighs hundreds of kilograms, carries the harsh sound of metal breaking and the sound of howling wind.
Lynch didn't look up.
[Feichen Mei’s Covenant] unfolds.
The force field exerted an oblique thrust on the side of the chandelier's falling path, deflecting the chandelier's falling trajectory by about fifteen degrees.
The chandelier rubbed his back and hit the ground. The loud impact of the iron frame and stone bricks made the entire hall tremble.
The candle bounced from the lampstand and rolled to the stone floor, its flames licking the cracks of the broken bricks.
The fragments splashed from behind, and Lynch did not look back. The repulsive force formed an invisible barrier behind him, blocking all the fragments half a meter away from his body.
Lamin didn't waste the window of time created by the chandelier's fall.
He followed behind the chandelier and stepped forward. He raised the dark dagger from bottom to top, aiming at Lynch's left wrist that held the sword.
The choice of this attack target exposed Lamin's judgment on the [Zhengchao Mark].
Laming could see clearly that a ray of light flashed on the back of the opponent's left hand when he was avoiding the influence of [Death Child]!
By destroying Lynch's left wrist first, the forbidden object and the left-hand sword can be destroyed at the same time.
This judgment is tactically correct.
But Lynch didn't give him a chance to touch his left wrist.
The muzzle of Judgment's gun poked out from under the sword's edge, and three bullets poured out.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Dang Dang Dang——
Lamin is no idiot!
Just because he doesn't know [Zhengchao Mark] doesn't mean he doesn't know [Judgment].
It was mentioned in [The Young Son] that this revolver-type [A-level forbidden object] was left to Isharis by Leon.
Laming could see very clearly that these three bullets were ordinary bullets without any enchantment. Just block them.
However...
Just when his blade touched the third bullet, he realized something was wrong.
Chapter 397 Gemstone Purple Egg!
The feeling coming from the dagger was wrong.
